title: Love Live! Hasunosora Anime Reveals New Trailer
content: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club anime revealed a new trailer on Saturday. The anime will premiere on January 10, 2027. Studio Sublimation is animating the series. Go Kurosaki is directing the series, with Haruko Iizuka on character designs, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa on music.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu' Gets 5th Season
content: The Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Starlight Party special event announced a fifth season on Saturday, revealing an ultra teaser visual (pictured). Produced by White Fox , the first anime season adapting Tappei Nagatsuki 's isekai fantasy light novel debuted in Spring 2016, covering the first nine volumes.

title: Gushing Over Magical Girls Anime's 2nd Season Debuts in 2027
content: Kadokawa revealed on Saturday that the second season of the anime based on Akihiro Ononaka 's Gushing Over Magical Girls ( Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete ) manga will debut in 2027, under the title Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete Season 2 ( Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 ). The new season was first announced in October 2024.

title: 5 Classic ’90s English Dub Anime That Surpass the Originals
content: The debate over which is better — subbed or dubbed anime — has persisted for years, but these English dubs streaming on Crunchyroll are some of the best in the game. Many anime fans are steadfast in the belief that all series should be viewed in their original Japanese forms.

title: Fan-Favorite Anime Confirms Season 4 Return After 3 Years With First Trailer – Watch
content: Laid-Back Camp , one of the most beloved slice-of-life anime of all time , is returning with a Season 4 next year. With the anime industry oversaturated with Shonen and action series, Laid-Back Camp is a breath of fresh air with its cozy and heartwarming vibe.
